source: keyboard obby but if you step on a key you get 1+ coins

image_prompt.text: A chain of giant keyboard keys as the platforms, laid out in QWERTY rows and spaced to physics limits, forming the route
Flat safe pads along the run where players respawn instead of restarting
Long horizontal jumps and stepped key heights between platforms
Keys that rotate, slide, or press down under the player

layout_placement.text: Respawn points at the safe pads along the keyboard

notes: Coins are awarded for stepping on a key rather than picked up off the ground, so `collectible-nodes` was not used - the reward is attached to the platform itself and has no separate placed object.
